note: The City Clerk requires licenses for specific business types and services; no blanket general business license is listed.

items.title: Obtain a Boise home occupation permit when required
items.authority: City of Boise Planning and Development Services
items.description: A business operated from a Boise home requires a home occupation permit when the city’s home-business conditions apply; zoning approval should be confirmed before operating.

penalty.note: The city's published pages for this item give no late-penalty amount.

items.title: Obtain a Boise building permit when required
items.authority: City of Boise Planning and Development Services
items.description: Boise’s building and development codes require the applicable permit for regulated construction and alterations; the city’s code directs applicants to the Planning and Development Services Building Division.

feeDetail.note: The fee is set in the city's permit fee schedule and depends on the scope or valuation of the work.

penalty.note: No penalty amount for work done without a permit was found in the city's published permit pages.

note: The City Clerk says the city does not require a general business license; specific activities (pawnbrokers, precious metal dealers, alcohol and others) need a license or permit.
The city does not issue general business licenses; licenses are required only for specific types of businesses such as alcohol, solicitors, pawnbrokers and alarm installers.
